postconditions.statement: For input {n, source, edges}, with n from 1 through 10 and edges [u, v, cost] where cost is an integer from -6 through 9, return a length-n distance list in vertex order. Unreachable vertices are null. Vertices reachable from a negative-cost cycle that is itself reachable from source are "-inf". Every other vertex has its minimum integer walk cost from source, which starts at distance zero. Support parallel edges and self-loops; unreachable negative cycles do not affect the output.

acceptance_criteria: Output follows the specified structure and ordering

The second public example returns [0, null, null]
